title: gallery-publish: publish each merged gallery app to the marketplace as an unmanaged template version (os package publish --submit), so customers can install it to try
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed task. In this seat's Claude Code session on 2026-11-18, the maintainer recalled that the scenario pipeline was to feed **unmanaged marketplace packages** and stated the goal, verbatim: 「客户可以从应用市场中下载安装试用」 (customers can download and install a gallery app from the marketplace to try it). Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Two cards, filed together: **card 1** #35132 (this lane, the package the exporter writes and the gate that proves it installs) and **card 2** (publishing it to the marketplace, Blocked-by card 1).

Card 2 of 2.

Blocked-by: #35266

## Problem (customer-visible)

A visitor sees a verified app on the gallery or on a www.objectos.ai scenario page and wants to try it in their own environment. The platform pieces exist:

- hosted unmanaged install (cloud#3624, cloud#3845, cloud#3690);
- seed copy on unmanaged install (#30808, #31425);
- the customer-code namespace for the copy (cloud#3648);
- a listing that is installable by link (cloud#3649);
- the sign-up deep link that installs a named template (cloud#3626).

But no gallery app is ever published to the marketplace, so none of these has anything to install. `os package publish --submit` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`) exists, but nothing calls it for gallery apps.

## Ask

1. **`gallery-publish`** in `@objectstack/scenarios`: for each app in a gallery checkout's `index.json` whose framework version has no published package version yet, run `os package publish --submit` from `apps/<id>/source`.
   - The package version follows the framework version, so each release yields a new snapshot.
   - The listing metadata comes from `index.json`, the screenshots and the app's `README.md`, including the 问数 transcript summary.
   - It is idempotent: a version already published is skipped and named as skipped.
   - Credentials come only from `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, never from a file in the gallery.
2. **When it runs:** after a `Gallery refresh for ObjectStack …` PR merges on objectstack-ai/gallery. Use a gallery workflow on push to `main` that runs the published `npx @objectstack/scenarios gallery-publish`. The seat opens that workflow PR on the gallery once the CLI is released. An app removed from the gallery (it failed on the new release) is not unpublished; its last good version stays installable. Say so in the README.
3. **The gallery README** replaces "Try it in ObjectOS cloud: planned" with the install path (marketplace listing and the cloud#3626 deep link), and each app's `README.md` links its listing.
4. Tests: version skip, metadata mapping, a missing key fails before any call, and dry-run output.

## Preconditions (maintainer-side; the seat asks when the CLI lands)

- **The publisher identity:** which ObjectOS Cloud organization publishes the official gallery templates, and an API key for it, stored as a secret on objectstack-ai/gallery. A seat creates neither.
- **Marketplace review:** whether gallery versions go through the normal review (cloud `docs/design/marketplace-review-on-approvals.md`) or an auto-approve rule for the official publisher. Also whether the listings are public in browse and search, or link-only (cloud#3649).

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue` once card 1 closes.
